content: Reconnaissance Methodology: Active and passive subdomain enumeration combining passive search engines (subfinder, assetfinder) with stochastic brute-forcing (puredns). Parse SSL Certificate Transparency logs via crt.sh to map legacy infrastructure. Extract PTR records via Reverse DNS mapping.

OWASP Amass & Open Asset Model (OAM): Perform organizational asset discovery using amass intel -asn <ASN>. Store target relationships in a graph database (amass db) to analyze connections between load balancers, IPs, and subdomains.
